name: Messenger to Darkshire
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
If I did not know Magistrate Solomon personally, I would say the man has gone mad.  Send the Night Watch to Lakeshire because Stormwind refuses aid?  The Night Watch was formed because Stormwind left us when this foul magic seeped into the land.  If I sent my Night Watch, this town would be overrun by evil before the guards even reached the forest's edge.

Take this letter of response to your Master in Lakeshire.
narrative.objectives: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Lord Ebonlocke's letter of response.
narrative.offerRewardText:
By the Light! The Stormwind Army retreated from Westfall. And the Guard no longer protects Darkshire? There is some treachery abound. How could this be so?

Oh I forgot to reward your service, Champion. Here are some coins. Now excuse me. Something is amiss in Stormwind and I must get to the bottom of it.
narrative.requestItemsText: Ah, good to see you back, messenger. Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?

quests.name: Messenger to Stormwind
quests.objectiveText: Magistrate Solomon has given you a report which must be delivered to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind.

quests.name: Messenger to Stormwind

quests.name: Messenger to Westfall
quests.objectiveText: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take his written plea to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.

quests.name: Messenger to Westfall
quests.objectiveText: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Gryan Stoutmantle's response.

quests.name: Messenger to Darkshire
quests.objectiveText: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take a letter to Lord Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
